form10.verdict: lead: helped single games (Brier 0.2135 -> 0.2130) but series got slightly worse (0.1938 -> 0.1942) in the full model; kept off

s16Prior.verdict: too few games: 62 PH S17-S18 games with 3+ players per side holding a Season 16 line; the fit hit its bound

s16WinPrior.verdict: too few games: 62 PH S17-S18 games with 3+ players per side holding a Season 16 line; the fit hit its bound

notes.method: Each feature uses only games before the one predicted, added on top of the full pre-game logit (ratings + draft). Fitted on the first 70% of games by date, judged on the last 30%. Adopt only if LR > 3.84 and held-out Brier improves; form was also re-run inside the whole model.
notes.comfort: player record on the picked hero (shrunk to 50%); comfort70 = picks with 15+ games at 70%+; familiar = games on the hero
notes.experience: career games in our data; intlExp = international games; careerWR = career win rate shrunk toward 50% (20-game prior)
notes.archLane: archetypes rebuilt from each player's earlier Season 18 games only (5+ games), lane-opponent matchup rates from earlier games
notes.menaDeaths: team deaths per game in earlier MENA S10 games
notes.s16Prior: Season 16 lines from the MPL PH staff stat posts: lineup KDA percentile within each lane, and S16 win rate shrunk toward 50%; used only for later (S17, S18) PH games, so nothing leaks

notTested.gkLongGames: game length is not known before a game, so a long-game edge cannot change a pre-game prediction
notTested.turtles: the model does not use turtle control
notTested.staffAllTime: the staff all-time and M-series totals include later games, so they would leak the future; career games and win rate were rebuilt from our own data instead
